apply_turbo_colormap: apply a turbo colormap to a monochrome tensor image and return a colored RGB image
depths_to_points: convert a depth map and camera view into 3D world-space points using intrinsics and extrinsics
depth_to_normal: compute a normalized surface normal map from a depth map and camera view using finite differences
build_render_utils_cli: build a python module that applies turbo colormap, depth to points, and depth to normal from render_utils
test_depths_to_points: test the depths_to_points function with a sample camera view and depth map tensor
